raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Skip `test_minimax_h3_dit_contract.py::test_group_attend_skips_only_the_trailing_alignment_rows` on ROCm. The test now requires CUDA and `torch.version.hip is None`, the same gate other diffusion unit tests use. No runtime code changes.

## Why

The test was added by #47566 and is gated only on `torch.cuda.is_available()`, which is true on ROCm. It builds a `DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl` directly. That backend is only selected by the CUDA platform; the ROCm platform never picks it. On ROCm, the test's shape (head size 128, 16400 rows) is not eligible for the cuDNN route, so `forward_varlen` falls through to the FlashAttention fallback, which imports `flash_attn`. The ROCm images do not ship that package, so the test fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'flash_attn'` on every AMD run since it landed:

- https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41450911971/job/125295715205
- https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41371177861/job/125041848501

The test checks a CUDA backend contract, so a skip loses no ROCm coverage. NVIDIA runs are unchanged.

## Test plan

- `python -m py_compile` on the changed file passes.
- Not run locally (needs a GPU).
- Passed on MI300 (rocm10) in a dispatched `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu-amd` run on this commit: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41514598474/job/125515049650 (the target test is SKIPPED; the shard finished with 1546 passed, 24 skipped).
- Passed in this PR's own PR Test (AMD) run: all four rocm10 `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu-amd` shards are green. The target test runs in shard 0, where it is SKIPPED (1546 passed, 24 skipped): https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41514817225/job/125604529223
- The red `multimodal-gen-test-2-gpu-amd` shard 0 in that run is `TestDisaggFlux3Image::test_t2i_and_edit_match_monolithic`, which fails the same way on main and is unrelated to this change.

     torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
 
 
-@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA")
+# DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl is a CUDA-platform backend; on ROCm its FlashAttention
+# fallback needs the flash_attn package, which the ROCm images do not ship.
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.version.hip is not None,
+    reason="requires CUDA (DynamicCudnnSDPAImpl is not selected on ROCm)",
+)
 def test_group_attend_skips_only_the_trailing_alignment_rows():

     forward_varlen and leaves the packing's alignment rows zero."""
